evidence.text: • Built a secure and modular Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) management system for enterprises, supporting account management,
periodic reporting, approval workflows, and document processing.
• Designed and implemented role-based access control (RBAC), permission management, and business workflows.
• Developed RESTful APIs using NestJS and TypeORM, handling business logic, data validation, and PostgreSQL data persistence.
• Designed database schema and optimized SQL queries to improve system performance.
• Implemented core features including report submission, multi-level approval processes, PDF/Excel generation, and automated email
• Developed file and image upload functionality and integrated Cloudinary for storage.
• Containerized and deployed the system using Docker and Docker Compose.
• Documented and tested APIs using Swagger (OpenAPI).
• Collaborated with team members using Git and GitHub.
• Overview: Developed a centralized multi-tenant administration platform to manage user accounts, complex organizational structures, and
event lifecycles with strict data consistency and role-based access control.
• Multi-Tenant Org & Membership Logic: Implemented soft-delete CRUD for organizations and built a membership system allowing
users to hold distinct roles across multiple organizations.
• Entity Status Management: Handled complex organizational state transitions and event lifecycles with strict data validation.
• Inventory Tracking: Developed logic to track real-time ticket capacity and prevent overbooking during event registration.
• Secure Authentication (JWT): Protected application routes and administrative APIs using JWT authentication and custom guards.
• Data Validation & Reporting: Applied DTO validation for data integrity and built a reporting module to aggregate system-wide
• Automated CI/CD & Cloud Deployment: Set up automated CI/CD pipelines to build, test, and deploy the application seamlessly
using Docker containers on Render and AWS infrastructure.
• Responsibilities: Full-stack development ( frontend, backend, database).
• Database & Cloud: PostgreSQL, TypeORM, AWS (S3, EC2)
• DevOps & Tools: GitHub Actions (CI/CD), Docker, Render, Swagger, JWT
